reference.instructions: Use brown wooden planks for the walking deck; simplify the structural tubes and reduce the number of lights.

objectiveRejectionCriteria: Walking surface does not read as brown wooden planks.
Structural rig restores dense repeated triangular trussing or exceeds four lamps.
A required part is cropped or obscured in all relevant review views.
Stairs do not reach the 0.64 metre deck with four equal risers.
Unsupported components, unintended clipping or floating ground supports remain after measured inspection.
Future runtime import changes approved dimensions, loses the wood appearance or breaks player access.
